hints.title: Include Boundary Restrictions
hints.text: Add boundary restriction [1, 0] and [n, n - 1] to clamp building heights within valid end coordinates.

hints.title: Two Way Restriction Relaxation
hints.text: Sort restrictions by building index and relax heights from left-to-right then right-to-left using difference limits.

hints.title: Peak Between Adjacent Restrictions
hints.text: Between two tight restrictions, the peak height is (h1 + h2 + (id2 - id1)) // 2.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building heights up to n = 10^9 cannot be simulated array by array.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting m restrictions and propagating slopes via two linear passes solves the problem in O(m log m) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate performs forward and backward slope relaxation and computes triangular peaks correctly.
